en: Dependent on a wholesome state that is surpassable, a state that is neither unsurpassed nor wholesome arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an unsurpassed wholesome state, a state that is neither unsurpassed nor wholesome arises by way of root condition. Under root [condition], there are two; ...
pe ... under non-disappearance [condition], there are two.

Dependent on a lower unwholesome state, a state that is neither higher nor unwholesome arises by way of root condition. Under root condition there is one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there is one. (In the unwholesome root, there are two conditions.)
